notes.title: Ralf Version 2.0 Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

Ralf is getting a FREE Update March 26, 2019! There is no need to do anything to receive this update. The next time you load Ralf from the Steam client, the update will be downloaded for you!

[h1]Here is what is coming in version 2.0[/h1]

[list]
[*] 3 new levels
[*] 3 new Steam Achievements
[*] Changes to the level select area to easier identify which levels are playable and complete
[*] Jump pads have been modified for better reliability
[/list]

[h1]New Levels and Achievements[/h1]

The new levels will be available after completing the main game final level and will test your play skills! You can look forward to larger levels with more enemies and less power ups for a real challenging experience.

Each level will also have a new Steam Achievement! The achievements will unlock after you complete the level, rescue all 5 caged Blobbers, clear the level collecting all 100 candies, clear with full health and clear with all enemy Blobbers KOed.

[h1]Level Select Changes[/h1]

Level select area has been expanded to include the new levels, with more room for expansion (hint, hint).

The Play Stats Hut now includes stats for the newly added levels as well as showing which levels have been cleared.

Lastly, Alongside each levels entry a Blobber will appear if the level is playable. His appearance will change depending on if the level has previously been cleared. A second Blobber will appear if all objectives in the level have been complete.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33854803/3bd6168f1e937f8e88fc1e50ecd44f5321da1cb7.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33854803/7a88fd67bf3ffe1521198ada8631f1d1a700c2e0.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33854803/2c8f1a0195aafc50116fa90064833c32dcfaf128.png[/img]

[h1]Thank you for your feedback[/h1]

Thank you to everyone who has provided feedback. The visual changes mentioned above were made after some players pointed out how it is difficult to identify which levels are playable.

The jump pad functionality was also redesigned after receiving feedback that there are odd times that they are unreliable. I hope these changes make for a more enjoyable playing experience.

Keep the feedback coming! More changes and even more levels are planned for version 3.0 coming later this year!

Follow Ralf on [url=https://twitter.com/RalfTheGame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://facebook.com/ralf.thegame.9]Facebook[/url] to stay up to date on the latest game news and receive game tips and tricks.

Thank you for your interest in Ralf! I hope you enjoy playing!

notes.title: Official Controller Configuration
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Here is the Official Controller Configuration for Ralf. It can be customized to your liking. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33854803/5ce2c9f09abc55288d1d13ac00430fba385d928f.png[/img]

To customize the controller configuration:
[list]
[*] Press SHIFT + TAB on your keyboard
[*] Select Controller Configuration
[*] Your screen should now look like the above image
[*] You can now select which in game action will be performed with which button.
[*] When you are done, return to the game and your new controller configuration should be ready to go
[/list]

Thank you for your interest in Ralf! I hope you enjoy playing!
